The surname '''al'Caar''' may refer to the following people:

*[[Adan al'Caar]] - a resident of the [[Two Rivers]] and once-target of [[Mat Cauthon]]'s tricks.
*[[Jac al'Caar]] - a shepherd of [[Emond's Field]].
*[[Jerilin al'Caar]] - a girl from  Emond's Field and [[Novice]] in the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Tower in exile]].
*[[Nela al'Caar]] - an older resident of the Two Rivers and wife of Paet.
*[[Paet al'Caar]] - a lantern-jawed man from the Two Rivers and husband of Nela.
*[[Tod al'Caar]] - a young Two Rivers man, a year younger than [[Perrin Aybara]].
*[[Wil al'Caar]] - son of Paet and Nela.
